Iggjel's '''friend''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who was part of the [[Wayland Herd]]. A [[tender]]-in-training, Iggjel's friend accompanied him when the young Ithorian left for the [[Mother Jungle/Legends|Mother Jungle]]<ref name="Iggjel" /> sometime before [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{CSWECite|II|80|Iggjel}} establishes that Iggjel was one of the Ithorian's first priests. ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', which took place in [[3951 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', features [[Chodo Habat]], an earliest established Ithorian priest in the timeline. Therefore, it can be deduced that the story took place sometime before 3951 BBY.</ref> although did not join him on the surface.<ref name="Iggjel" />
